theorem sum_R3' {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR0 : 0 < R) (hRD : R < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R⌋ ⌊D⌋, Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * (x / R + x / q * Real.log (D / R)) +
        2 * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π * q *
          (√(1 + q / R) + (D - R) / q + 1 / 2 * Real.log (D / R)) :=

note: All m in (R, D] are kept, including q | m (since |T_m| ≥ 0), so no Q/2 restriction is needed, in Lean as in the book. The book's '(4.26) gets halved' for Lemma 4.2.2 is the coefficient 3c₁/2 in block_R3.
